entries.title: Leave purchase orders without unnecessary save prompts
entries.description: Approved and read-only orders no longer attempt to autosave or block navigation and reloads. Untouched drafts also avoid unnecessary saves after background updates.

entries.title: Name the operator on every stock movement
entries.description: Stock movement forms now let you select the person doing the work. Your name is selected by default, while shared devices require an operator to be chosen.

entries.title: Print clearer part labels and staff badges
entries.description: Labels and badges now use larger QR codes sized for 40 × 30 mm label stock. Badge printing is also available for staff beyond the stores role.

entries.title: Keep new part codes within the label limit
entries.description: Newly entered part codes are limited to 13 characters. Existing longer codes remain readable.

entries.title: Scan new QR labels and existing barcodes
entries.description: The stores camera scanner now accepts QR codes on part labels and staff badges while continuing to read older barcodes.

entries.title: Select more staff as stores operators
entries.description: The stores quick-switch now includes active staff beyond the stores role, so the person doing the work can be named.
